With that accomplished, go to the north. And then, make an effort to take a trip west. With that done, move south. And then, venture west. After that, move west. Then, make an effort to head north. That done, make an effort to move west. With that done, make an effort to travel north. After that, attempt to travel east. Then, venture north. And then, go east. Next, pick up the coin from the floor of the bedroom. And once you've done that, you win!
